concept: Original cozy pastel pixel-art cottage and garden
prompt: Create one original landscape 16:9 background artwork for an adult cozy bedtime-story channel called Quiet Little Worlds. No text, no logo, no border. Art direction is AUTHENTIC carefully hand-pixeled 2D pixel art, reminiscent of an exquisitely crafted indie cozy game's environmental background. A consistent visibly square pixel grid, deliberate pixel clusters, stair-step contours, 32-48 harmonious colors, selective sparse dithering. No 3D, no watercolor, no painterly brushstrokes, no smooth gradients or blurry bloom. Beautiful muted PASTEL palette: dusty lavender dusk, sage and mint leaves, powder blue and soft teal water, warm peach and butter-yellow lamplight. Calm, sheltered and inviting, moderately bright and readable with soft contrast, not dark horror. Composition: a tiny charming wooden gardener's cottage takes up the left third, with a clearly shaped brick chimney on its roof and a large warm glowing rectangular window showing a cozy reading nook inside, a small greenhouse extension, neatly arranged terracotta plant pots, books on the interior sill, simple warm wooden steps and a garden path. A beautiful shallow lily pond occupies the lower-right third, with clear open water for future animated pixel ripples; leave the open water clean with just a few simple static reflection pixel lines and lily pads near the shore. Rich layered garden: clusters of pastel flowers, ferns, moss-covered stones, small mushrooms, overhanging willow leaves near the top right, softly silhouetted trees behind. Open lavender sky visible in the upper center and right with two clean pale-pink clouds. Intimate small-world scale, strong clear shapes, thoughtful cozy pixel-game composition and fine detail without noisy speckling. The cottage and foreground plants should feel handmade and precisely pixeled. Absolutely no human characters, no creatures or faces, no visible rain, no painted fireflies, no smoke, no animated effect baked into the still: those will be animated as separate sprites later. Static beautiful base scene. Emphasize artisanal genuine pixel-art craftsmanship and cohesive pixel scale; think a native 480x270 pixel canvas cleanly enlarged with nearest-neighbor. Full-bleed landscape image, not an isometric floating island.
